newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee prices ease on low quality.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee prices ease on low quality.

text.p: Lower quality of coffee on sale forced coffee prices to ease by $5-8 on Tuesday at the weekly Kenya coffee auction, coffee auction officials said.

Grade AA's averaged $159.5 per 50-kg bag from $162, while grade AB's averaged $157 from $156. Traders said the number of good coffees were few, with main coffee buyers still short. News that the coffee auction would start operating as an exchange caught many traders by suprise -- they expected the exchange to begin operations sometime in January 1997.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 24,651 60-kg bags of coffee it had on offer compared to 19,282 bags last week.
